recent.text: Final: HEAT 104, Sixers 111 Antetokounmpo: 32pts, 13rebs, 2stls Mitchell: 20pts, 10asts Adebayo: 17pts, 11rebs
recent.author: Miami HEAT

recent.text: FINAL: Sixers 111, Heat 104 Miami drops the NBA Cup game courtesy of a LeBron James triple-double for Philadelphia. Giannis finished with a 32 & 14 double-double, Davion Mitchell 20 & 10. Seven-game win streak snapped.
recent.author: Hot Hot Hoops

recent.text: FINAL: Sixers 111, Heat 104 - Antetokounmpo 32pts/14reb/4ast - Mitchell 20pts/3reb/10ast - Adebayo 17pts/11reb/3ast The Heat drop to 10-7 with the loss. They continue their road trip in New York on Friday.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: After review, they are upgrading that foul on Giannis Antetokounmpo to a Flagrant 1 for hitting Dean Wade in the face on that block attempt. Sixers up, 106-95, with 4:22 left.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Great work by the 76ers to make Klay Thompson work tonight. They've worked really hard to get over screens and keep him from getting anything easy. He's only 1-of-5 from 3 and the Heat are 8-of-27 from deep overall. Sixers up, 104-93, with 5:36 left.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Both teams scored 28 points in the third quarter, so the deficit stays at nine for the Heat. Philadelphia leads, 90-81, heading to the fourth quarter. Giannis Antetokounmpo leads the Heat with 27 points, eight rebounds and four assists.
recent.author: Eric Nehm
recent.quoted_text: Miami will need to find some extra stops as this one goes along and that has not often been easy for them. They're playing the 76ers roughly even and with a nine-point halftime deficit that is just not going to be enough. Sixers up, 82-72, with 3:39 left in the third quarter.

recent.text: Yes, a Bobby Portis chase-down block . . . followed by a stare down.
recent.author: Ira Winderman

recent.text: Half: Sixers 62, Heat 53 - Antetokounmpo 16pts/5reb/3ast - Mitchell 12pts/4ast - Wiggins 6pts/2reb LeBron James has 16pts/6reb/6ast on the other side for the 76ers. Philadelphia is also 7-of-14 from 3.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Difference so far in this one feels like the 3-point line. The 76ers have made six of their 13 attempts from deep, meanwhile the Heat have hit only three of their 13 tries after that miss by Andrew Wiggins. Philadelphia leads, 51-47, with 2:58 left in the first half.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: That's an absurd finish by Giannis Antetokounmpo. Got hit by a couple Sixers. Not even sure how he saw the rim.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: After one quarter, the Heat have a 32-29 lead in Philadelphia. Giannis Antetokounmpo leads the way for Miami with 8pts/5reb/3ast, but Davion Mitchell has 6pts/2ast as well.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo with a quick 8pts/5reb/3ast in nine minutes, but LeBron James is orchestrating things for the 76ers. He has five assists, while Tyrese Maxey has a quick 11 points. Heat still lead, 26-23, with 2:49 left in the first quarter though.
recent.author: Eric Nehm
